You were our first&mdash;I'm rather proud of the ''Ottdefa''.|[[Duttes Mer]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]|<ref name="Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu]]''</ref>}}
The '''Dela system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]], a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dela III]].

==History==
The Dela system had strict security measures within it to protect the [[Bank/Legends|banks]] of [[Dela III]] from [[Renatasian]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorists]] and other [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] groups.<ref name="ACGttC" />
